title: FoDrops
description: Create FULLY Custom Drops for ANYTHING in 4 Clicks.
body:
![Cover Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b404fa0c486687cf72271cf88df31a1093bf9df9.png)

**Build custom drops for blocks, mobs, fishing, crafting, explosions, and more without hand-editing bulky configs.**

FoDrops is an admin-focused Paper/Spigot/Purpur plugin for creating and managing custom drop profiles in-game. You can define what event should trigger a drop, add multiple reward entries with their own chances and amount ranges, control where items are delivered, and gate everything behind conditions like world, biome, tool, enchantments, time, weather, target type, permission, and per-player cooldowns.
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c65859df7b05a97432f74fed54fce87e216d801c.png)

## Features
- Create and manage drop profiles entirely in-game through a paginated GUI editor.
- Cover multiple trigger types, including block breaking, mob kills, fishing, crafting, shearing, entity drops, and explosion-based events.
- Add multiple custom drop entries per profile with configurable chance, amount range, and delivery mode.
- Restrict drops by world, biome, target type, required permission, tool type, Silk Touch mode, Fortune level, time range, weather, and cooldown.
- Control priority between profiles, stop lower-priority profiles after a match, and optionally cancel vanilla drops.
- Attach console or player commands to each drop entry for extra rewards, effects, or integrations.
- Works with FoAutocollect & FoDropBooster

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9a46b1a4117408444d5d3a4b0525ebd56d4241d.png)

## Event And Reward Control
FoDrops is built around reusable drop profiles. Each profile can target a specific event, be ordered by priority, and decide whether it should replace vanilla drops or run alongside them. That makes it practical for everything from custom ore drops to special mob rewards, fishing tables, crafting bonuses, and admin-controlled loot systems.

Each custom drop entry can:
- Use its own percentage chance
- Use a fixed amount or min-max range
- Deliver items to the ground or directly into the player's inventory
- Run follow-up commands as `console` or `player`

## Fine-Grained Conditions
Profiles can be as broad or as strict as you need. You can target specific materials or entity keys, limit drops to certain worlds or biomes, require a permission node, match specific tools or tool tags like `tag:pickaxe`, and check enchantment state with Silk Touch and Fortune requirements.

Time-of-day, weather, and per-player cooldown rules are also built in, so rare drops can stay rare without extra plugins or complex scripting.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/581773420b6438d1236c8f643aeb3378ba5f8169.png)

## Commands
- `/fodrops editor` - Open the in-game drop editor
- `/fodrops version` - Show plugin version info

## Permissions
- `fodrops.admin` - Full access to FoDrops commands and editor

## Admin Notes
Command actions support useful placeholders such as `{player}`, `%player%`, `{uuid}`, `{world}`, `{event}`, `{item}`, and `{amount}`. This makes it easy to connect drops to economy rewards, broadcasts, progression systems, or other server plugins through commands.
